name: Authority Delegation
description: A time-bounded transfer of specified actions from an accountable person to another, recorded so that 'who was acting for whom, when' is answerable (02-data-model.md §4.3). It grants no framework permission: it is evaluated by application logic at the point of action and recorded on the resulting decision or task.

fields.label: Scope DocType
fields.description: Required for the DocType, Record and Forum scopes. A Forum scope names the forum DocType here; the model's separate scope_forum column is not built, because Core cannot link to a module entity.

fields.label: Scope Record
fields.description: Required for the Record and Forum scopes.

fields.label: Valid To
fields.description: An open-ended delegation is permitted; a closed one is preferred.

fields.label: Active
fields.description: Derived from the dates on save and by the daily sweep; stored so queries need not compute it.

fields.label: Delegated Actions
fields.description: Which actions transfer. Administrative actions only, unless a non-administrative action is deliberately enabled on the taxonomy row.
